leadText:
Diablo's Ocean (Japanese: 魔の海域 Demon's Ocean) is an -exclusive location in the Sinnoh region. It was featured in Cheers on Castaways Isle!. It is located somewhere between Iron Island and Chocovine Town.

The area is known for meteor showers, and the fallen rocks lay off the coast of a deserted island and give off a special magnetic field which causes navigation tools and instrumentation to go haywire or even break.

On the deserted island, the local were gathering meteor fragments to help restore a whose crystal landed on the island during a storm. The Mythical Pokémon was later revived after receiving help from Ash's Pikachu and Dawn's Piplup.

==Trivia==
Diablo's Ocean is based on the , an area where many naval and aerial vehicles have sunk into the ocean because of powerful magnetic forces. This is further enforced by the Japanese name of "Demon's Ocean", similar to the alias of the Bermuda, "Devil's Triangle".
